definitions.explanation: A cemetery or burial ground, often a large, well-maintained park-like facility. Used for both public and private cemeteries.

examples.japanese: {霊園|れいえん}にお{墓参|はかまい}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go visit a grave at the cemetery.

examples.japanese: {市営|しえい}{霊園|れいえん}の{区画|くかく}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I applied for a plot at the municipal cemetery.

examples.japanese: この{霊園|れいえん}は{緑|みどり}が{多|おお}く、{静|しず}かな{環境|かんきょう}にある。
examples.english: This cemetery has lots of greenery and is in a quiet setting.

notes: Often used in the formal names of cemeteries: {多磨|たま}{霊園|れいえん} (Tama Cemetery), {青山|あおやま}{霊園|れいえん} (Aoyama Cemetery). Common collocations: {公営|こうえい}{霊園|れいえん} (public cemetery), {民営|みんえい}{霊園|れいえん} (private cemetery), {霊園|れいえん}の{管理|かんり} (cemetery maintenance). Compare with {墓地|ぼち} (graveyard — more general), {墓園|ぼえん} (cemetery — less common). {霊園|れいえん} tends to suggest a larger, more modern, park-style facility.
